name: FLUX.2 Base Image
description: Text-to-image with the FLUX.2 base model. High-fidelity stills from a prompt — no LoRA, no source image.

requirements.notes: TESTED 2026-09-07 on RTX 4070 Ti (12.9GB VRAM + 17GB RAM). FLUX.2-dev is ~32B: fp8 weights=35GB, +12GB text encoder. Exceeds a 12GB card's total memory and spills to SSD. Real timing on 12GB: 32 min @24 steps, 15 min @8-step turbo, 18 min with Q3_K_S GGUF+turbo. No quant makes it usable locally. Needs a 24GB+ GPU (e.g. RunPod) for practical speed. For fast local iteration use Pony/SDXL and composite text separately.
